purpose: Semantic action vocabulary for goal-directed Agent decisions. Strategy chooses WHAT; Behavior Policy chooses HOW naturally; CDP Executor performs browser-native input/navigation.

targeting.rule: Strategy must not emit raw CSS selectors, coordinates, or CDP method names as the primary action representation.

boundaries.behaviorPolicy: derive context-conditioned natural execution profile from human demonstrations
boundaries.cdpPlanner: turn semantic action + behavior profile into exact CDP execution plan
boundaries.executor: dispatch CDP commands and report low-level execution result
